questions.question: Calculate the molality of a solution containing 5g of NaOH in 100g of water. (Molecular mass of NaOH = 40)
questions.explanation: Molality = moles of solute/kg of solvent = (5/40)/(100/1000) = 0.125/0.1 = 1.25 m.
